title: A MESSAGE FROM #JOB
segments: find myself facing unimaginable trials
and suffering
I witness how my life takes a severe
turn
as I lose everything I once had my
possessions my loved ones
and even my health
it's a period of great Despair and pain
despite the overwhelming challenges I am
unwavering in my faith and trust in God
I choose to hold on to the belief that
there is a purpose to these trials even
in the midst of my confusion and sorrow
I refuse to let bitterness and anger
consume me and instead I find this
strength Within Me
to persevere
it is not an easy Journey
the suffering testify endurance
and pushes me to my limits yet
I choose to display real Grit
to cling to my faith even when it seems
there is no reason to hold on to it
I find resilience Within Myself
a determination to keep going
and not give up
though my rib tempted me to curse God in
my moments of Anguish I resisted that
Temptation I recognize that blaming God
for my hardships will not alleviate my
pain or provide answers instead I chant
on my energy into staying steadfast in
my beliefs
trusting that there is a higher purpose
beyond my comprehension
in the end I may not fully understand
the reasons behind my suffering
but I choose to remain faithful and
trusting in God
my prayers is that my brothers after me
will endure through hardships with
resilience
maintaining faith in times of darkness
and displaying real
Godly Grit
